---
title: "Polygenic Risk Scores"
format: html
editor: visual
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

# Read in Datasets
load("C:/r_course/BIOL90042_GROUP_4_PROJECT/BIOL90042_Group_Project/data/prs.Rda")

# Pivot the data longer so that beta can be assigned to each locus for each individual
genotypes_longer <- ca_co_genotypes |> 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("locus_"),
    names_to = "locus",
    values_to = "allele_frequency"
  )
# Assign the beta value to each locus for each individual
genotypes_longer_beta <- left_join(
  genotypes_longer,
  gwas_top_hits,
  by = "locus"
)

# Determine the contribution of each SNP towards the PRS
genotypes_longer_beta_contribution <- genotypes_longer_beta |> 
  mutate(contribution = allele_frequency * beta)

# Sum each SNP's contribution to the PRS for each individual, noting disease status
prs_scores <- genotypes_longer_beta_contribution |> 
  group_by(donorid,status) |> 
  summarise(PRS=sum(contribution)) |>
  ungroup()

# Find Individual with highest and lowest PRS
prs_scores |> 
  slice_max(PRS, n = 1)
prs_scores |> 
  slice_min(PRS, n = 1)
'''
```

```{r}
# Density plot gives a good perspective on the shift that status has with polygenic risk status
ggplot(data = prs_scores, aes(x = PRS, colour = status))+
  geom_density() +
  labs(
    x = "Polygenic Risk Score",
    y = "Density",
    colour = "Status",
    title = "Polygenic Risk Distribution For Parkinsons Patients and Controls") +
  theme_minimal ()

# Boxplot gives an easy visualisation for the basic 5 figure summary
ggplot(data = prs_scores, aes(x = PRS, y = status))+
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(
    x = "Polygenic Risk Score",
    y = "Case/Control Status",
    title = "Polygenic Risk Distribution For Parkinsons Patients and Controls") +
  theme_minimal ()

# Comparison of 5 figure summarry
prs_scores |> 
  group_by (status) |> 
  summarise(
    n=n(),
    mean = mean(PRS),
    median = median(PRS),
    sd = sd(PRS),
    minimum = min(PRS),
    maximum = max(PRS))

# Normal Distribution
ggplot(data = prs_scores, aes(sample = PRS)) +
  geom_qq() +
  geom_qq_line() +
  facet_wrap(~status)

# Test Statistic
t.test(PRS ~ status, data = prs_scores, var.equal = TRUE)
```
